title: ToolCallEnvelope / ToolResultEnvelope
description: The typed input/output contract every tool in tools/ must satisfy. Wraps the tool's own input/output schema with harness-level metadata so validation, idempotency, and scoping are uniform across tools. See reference/multi-agent-architecture-notes.md sections 6-8.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated key. The harness must treat repeated calls with the same key as a single logical operation.

agentRole.description: Which agent role is invoking the tool, checked against that role's scoped tool list before execution.

input.description: Validated against the individual tool's own JSON Schema, referenced by toolName.

delegationDepth.description: How many agent-to-agent hops produced this call; the harness rejects calls exceeding the configured cap.

output.description: Present when status is ok. Should be small; route large payloads through the artifact store and return an artifact-ref instead.

error.description: Present when status is error or rejected. Classified deterministically by the harness (classifyError) so retry/escalation policy is code-driven, never parsed from a message string. See reference/multi-agent-architecture-notes.md section 12.

type.description: transient: timeout/5xx/rate-limit -> bounded auto-retry. permanent: not-found/business-rule -> no retry, final. validation: bad input -> no retry, surface so the model can correct params. auth: credential/permission failure -> no retry, logged as a security event, reason not exposed to the model beyond 'not permitted'.

retryable.description: Derived from type (true only for transient). The orchestrator's retry loop keys off this, not off the message text.
